title: Patient Payment Plans Installment Agreement: Signing the Agreement and Its Signed Figures
content:
A proposed plan under the Patient Payment Plans becomes active when the patient signs the installment agreement, accepting the monthly installment, the down payment and the due date of installment 1 written into it. The signed installment is worked out at signing for the agreement the patient signs.

## Conditions of the signed figures

1. The signed installment is fixed only after the plan balance carries the setup-fee entry the tier owes at signing.
2. The signed installment is not fixed until the plan carries an enrollment entry for every charge the financial account posted for an encounter already enrolled on it.
3. Any down payment above 0.00 is paid at signing as an extra payment of the kind down payment.

Put in terms of the records: on a tier that owes a setup fee at signing, the signed installment is one worked out on a plan balance that already shows that setup-fee entry; and every charge the Patient Financial Account shows posted to an encounter the plan already carries has its own enrollment entry on the plan before the signed installment is fixed.

## Signature: `sign_installment_agreement_b4bb7ade`

**Capability.** The patient signs the installment agreement of a proposed payment plan in their own name, accepting the monthly installment, the down payment and the due date of installment 1 written into it. One call turns the proposed plan into an active plan: its status becomes active, today becomes its signing date, and the installment, down payment and installment-1 due date given are written onto the plan. No payment is taken by this signature.

**Invocation.** This is the patient's own tool. The representative unlocks it for the patient with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves, the patient, runs it (`call_user_discoverable_tool`) to sign.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payment_plan_id` | Reference number of the proposed payment plan being signed, as read to the patient from the payment plan lookup | Identifier |
| `installment_amount` | The monthly installment written into the agreement | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored exactly as given, rounded half up to 2 decimal places |
| `down_payment_usd` | The down payment written into the agreement | USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when none is due; stored exactly as given, rounded half up to 2 decimal places |
| `first_due_date` | The due date of installment 1 | Calendar date in the format YYYY-MM-DD (Eastern time calendar day), stored exactly as given |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the payment plan reference, its new status active, the signing date (YYYY-MM-DD), the monthly installment and the down payment in USD with 2 decimal places, and the due date of installment 1 (YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving this sentence means the agreement is signed and in force; the plan then shows status active with the signed terms.
